meta.name: add-matrix
meta.description: Add Matrix channel integration via Chat SDK. Works with any Matrix homeserver.

copy.tagline: 让应用快速接入 Matrix 聊天频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里集成 Matrix 通讯渠道
copy.tagline_en: Add Matrix chat channels to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate Matrix messaging into your app

howto.what: 它把 Matrix 频道适配器加进你的项目：从 channels 分支复制适配器文件、追加注册导入、装指定版本的适配器包、修补 ESM 导入，再跑构建和注册测试。完成后项目可连接任意 Matrix homeserver。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 项目接入 Matrix 频道时接管，比如让它连到某个 Matrix homeserver；机器人账号凭据需要你自己在 Element 上注册并按提示交互完成。

say.text: 把 Matrix 频道加进来，homeserver 用 matrix.org
say.note: 会复制注册适配器、装包并跑构建

say.text: 用用户名密码方式配置 Matrix 机器人
say.note: 会提示你填机器人登录名和密码

say.text: 跑一遍 matrix-registration 测试看有没有漂移
say.note: 红了说明桶文件导入或依赖装错了

howto.what_en: Adds Matrix channel support to your project: copies the adapter from the channels branch, registers the import, installs a pinned adapter package, patches ESM imports, then builds and runs a registration test.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a Matrix channel to the NanoClaw project, e.g. connect it to a Matrix homeserver. Credentials need a separate bot account you register yourself.

say_en.text: Add the Matrix channel, using matrix.org as the homeserver
say_en.note: Copies and registers the adapter, then builds

say_en.text: Configure the Matrix bot with username and password auth
say_en.note: Prompts for the bot login and password

say_en.text: Run the matrix-registration test to check for drift
say_en.note: Red means the import or install drifted
